Morning team,

We need to lock the November monthly/QBR pipeline hygiene items and produce the leadership-ready bundle by the 14th. This thread is the playbook and routing for manager-level work -> exec binder. High level asks:

1) Update stage + commit status in HubSpot for all open deals by COB Nov 10. Use the attached Forecast Synchrony template if helpful.
2) Flag any deals that require an exec exception (pricing, SLA, compliance) with the tag "exec_review" in HubSpot and drop the deal id into the sheet.
3) Submit one leadership one-pager per flagged deal (use the exec_one_pager_template.docx). I will collate.

Quick operational notes:
- Owners should prioritize ACME-2027-1784 and ACME-2027-1812 — both are included in the QBR working set.
- For stage changes, include the reason: (forecastable / at-risk / delayed vendor).
- If you need supporting evidence (SOC2, retention policy), attach the stub to the deal and ping Mina.

Linked resources: Drive folder with templates and the snapshot export (first pass): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_forecast_sync
HubSpot snapshot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/ACME-2027-1784

I propose a 30-min sync on Nov 12 @ 10:00 PT for triage of flagged items and a final leadership packet handoff on Nov 14 @ 9:00 PT (I put a placeholder on calendars). Please reply with:
- Confirmed (I’ll update by Nov 10) OR
- Escalation (I need help, list reason)

Thanks — short and sharp here.

PRIYOM DAS
Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
